changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'StagingScoreItem') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[StagingScoreItem] ( AllocationUid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, AssetUid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, MeasureUid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, MeasureVersionUid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, EffectiveDate datetime NOT NULL, [Value] bit NULL, DecimalValue float NULL, RawWeight decimal(8, 6) NULL, ConditionUid uniqueidentifier NULL, Evidence nvarchar(max) NOT NULL, OtherConditions nvarchar(max) NOT NULL, IsRemoved bit constraint DF_MetricsStagingScoreItem_IsRemoved default(0) not null, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricsStagingScoreItem] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [AssetUid] ASC, MeasureUid ASC, EffectiveDate DESC ) ) END
if not exists(select * from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'StagingScoreItem' and COLUMN_NAME = 'HasThreshold') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[StagingScoreItem] ADD HasThreshold bit constraint DF_MetricsStagingScoreItem_HasThreshold default(0) not null end
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'StagingScoreItem') BEGIN DROP TABLE [metrics].[StagingScoreItem] END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricsStagingScoreItem_Evidence') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[StagingScoreItem] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsStagingScoreItem_Evidence] DEFAULT ('{}') FOR [Evidence] end
if not exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricsStagingScoreItem_OtherConditions') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[StagingScoreItem] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsStagingScoreItem_OtherConditions] DEFAULT ('[]') FOR [OtherConditions] end
changeSet.rollback:
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricsStagingScoreItem_Evidence') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[StagingScoreItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsStagingScoreItem_Evidence] end
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricsScoreItem_OtherConditions') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[StagingScoreItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsScoreItem_OtherConditions] end

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Metrics_StagingScoreItem_AllocationUid_AssetUid_EffectiveDate') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Metrics_StagingScoreItem_AllocationUid_AssetUid_EffectiveDate] ON [metrics].[StagingScoreItem] ([AllocationUid], [AssetUid], [EffectiveDate]) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Metrics_StagingScoreItem_AllocationUid_AssetUid_EffectiveDate') BEGIN DROP INDEX [IX_Metrics_StagingScoreItem_AllocationUid_AssetUid_EffectiveDate] ON [metrics].[StagingScoreItem] END
